app_description: An app for controlling the Manafish ROV
rov_connection_settings_page_description: Configure the ROV's connection settings. Changing these settings can brick your ROV so you have to flash it manually from scratch. It is important that the IP address and port matches what the app expects.
rov_connection_ip_address_description: The IP address of the ROV.
rov_connection_websocket_port_descriptio: The port the ROV will use for the WebSocket server.
app_connection_page_description: Configure your connection settings. Only change this if you know what you are doing.
app_connection_ip_address_description: The IP address of your Manafish.
app_connection_webrtc_signaling_api_port: The port number for the WebRTC signaling API (used for establishing the video stream connection).
app_connection_webrtc_signaling_api_path: The path for the WebRTC signaling API.
app_connection_web_socket_port_descripti: The port number for the WebSocket connection (used for controlling the ROV and obtaining status).

alerts_app_update_description: It is important to keep both the app and firmware on their latest versions. Running mismatched versions can cause compatibility issues.
general_settings_appearance_theme_descri: Select the color scheme for the application.

general_rov_settings_page_description: Generic settings for the Manafish ROV.
general_rov_settings_rov_name_descriptio: A custom name for this ROV. This name is shown in the sidebar and helps identify the ROV.
general_rov_settings_firmware_version_de: Current version of the Manafish ROV firmware.
general_rov_settings_config_backup_descr: Export the current ROV configuration to a JSON file or restore one from a previous export. Useful before firmware updates so you can recover your tuning if anything changes.

firmware_update_drives_empty: No SD cards found. Insert the ROV's SD card into your computer.

sd_flash_versions_unavailable_descriptio: Could not load the list of available firmware versions. Check your internet connection and try again.
sd_flash_flash_status_flashed: SD card flashed successfully. Eject it from your computer and put it back in the ROV.
sd_flash_step_firmware_desc: Choose the firmware version to install on the ROV.
sd_flash_step_sd_card_desc: Pick the ROV's SD card to write to.

general_rov_settings_mcu_page_descriptio: Configure the thruster protocol, DShot speed, and ESC current sensing mode.
general_rov_settings_firmware_page_descr: View and update the ROV computer, thruster microcontroller, and ESC firmware.
general_rov_settings_mcu_board_descripti: Select the microcontroller unit board type to flash the correct unified firmware image.
general_rov_settings_thruster_protocol_d: Select the active thruster output protocol. DShot 300 is recommended as it supports telemetry and is not very susceptible to noise. PWM is simpler but has no telemetry.
general_rov_settings_dshot_speed_descrip: Select the DShot bitrate. DShot1200 requires Pico 2.
general_rov_settings_current_sensing_mod: How ESC current is measured. Use 'Shared bus' for 4-in-1 ESCs with a single current sensor. Use 'Per motor' for individual ESCs with their own current sensor.
general_rov_settings_fluid_type_descript: Select the fluid type to ensure accurate depth readings. Saltwater and freshwater have slightly different densities.
general_rov_settings_smoothing_factor_de: Controls the input smoothing for ROV movement. Higher values yield smoother motion but reduce responsiveness. A value of 1 means it takes 1 second to reach full power. We recommend keeping this at 0 when using a gamepad or joystick.
calibration_page_description: Calibrate the thrusters of the ROV.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_descripti: Configure each thruster connected to your ROV. For each pin, click 'Test' to spin the motor, then match it to your thruster chart and enter its number under 'Identifier'. Finally, check the spin direction and set it to 'Normal' if it matches your chart, or 'Reversed' if not.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_pin_toolt: The general purpose pin on the microcontroller unit that the thruster is connected to.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_identifie: The number shown next to the thruster on the thruster chart.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_spin_dire: What direction the motor spins by default when pressing test button.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_test_tool: Spins the thruster slowly in the specified direction on the specified pin.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_rpm_toolt: The revolutions per minute of the thruster.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_signal_qu: DShot telemetry signal quality. Shows the percentage of valid packets over a 600ms window. 100% is perfect.
calibration_thruster_allocation_descript: Configure how each thruster responds to movement inputs. Each row represents a movement direction. Assign values to indicate which thrusters should activate: positive values produce forward thrust, negative values produce reverse thrust, and 0 disables the thruster.
calibration_thruster_allocation_identifi: The number shown next to the thruster on the thruster chart.
calibration_thruster_allocation_surge_to: Thrusters to activate to move forward
calibration_thruster_allocation_sway_too: Thrusters to activate to move right
calibration_thruster_allocation_heave_to: Thrusters to activate to move down (deeper)
calibration_thruster_allocation_pitch_to: Thrusters to activate to pitch up (nose up)
calibration_thruster_allocation_yaw_tool: Thrusters to activate to yaw right (nose right)
calibration_thruster_allocation_roll_too: Thrusters to activate to roll right (left side lifted)
calibration_thruster_allocation_action_1: Thrusters to activate for action 1 (custom or auxiliary function).
calibration_thruster_allocation_action_2: Thrusters to activate for action 2 (custom or auxiliary function).
regulator_page_description: PID-regulator settings for Manafish, responsible for auto-stabilization and depth hold.
regulator_pid_pitch_rate_description: Decides how fast the desired pitch will change in degrees per second. Setting this value too high might cause unpredictable movement.
regulator_pid_roll_rate_description: Decides how fast the desired roll will change in degrees per second. Setting this value too high might cause unpredictable movement.
regulator_pid_yaw_rate_description: Decides how fast the desired yaw will change in degrees per second. Setting this value too high might cause unpredictable movement.
regulator_pid_depth_rate_description: Decides how fast the desired depth will change in meters per second. Setting this value too high might cause unpredictable movement.
regulator_pid_roll_description: Rotation around the axis passing from the middle of the front cap to rear cap.
regulator_fpv_mode_description: In FPV mode the pitch regulator follows the pilot's view instead of stabilizing to a fixed angle.
regulator_pid_run_auto_tuning: Run Auto Tuning (DOES NOT WORK YET)
regulator_direction_coefficients_descrip: These coefficients describe the ROV's movement speed in different directions. The ratios between them determine how much each thruster activates during depth hold to prevent drift.
camera_settings_page_description: Adjust the camera and video stream. Changes take effect right away.
camera_settings_stream_description: Settings for the live video feed from the ROV.
camera_settings_image_description: Adjustments applied to the camera image.
camera_settings_resolution_description: How detailed the video looks. Higher resolutions show more detail but use more bandwidth and may increase lag.
camera_settings_crop_fov_description: Zooms in slightly at lower resolutions to allow a higher frame rate, at the cost of a narrower view.
camera_settings_framerate_description: How smooth the video looks. Use 20 or 30 fps and lower the resolution to reduce bandwidth; higher frame rates and resolutions use more bandwidth.
mcu_protocol_power_cycle_description: The thruster protocol or DShot rate was changed. Disconnect the thruster battery, wait for every ESC to power down, then reconnect it before operating the motors. The ROV computer can remain powered if it has a separate supply.
toasts_pi_undervoltage_title: ROV computer supply voltage is too low
toasts_pi_undervoltage_description: The Raspberry Pi detected low input voltage. Check its 5 V supply and wiring. If power is marginal, lower the camera resolution or frame rate to reduce load.
camera_settings_automatic_bitrate_descri: Automatically picks a bitrate that balances picture quality with smooth playback for your resolution and frame rate. Turn off to set it yourself.
camera_settings_bitrate_description: How much data the video uses. Higher values look sharper but need a better connection to stay smooth.
camera_settings_keyframe_interval_descri: How quickly the video recovers after a signal drop. Lower values recover faster but use more bandwidth.
camera_settings_profile_description: Baseline gives the lowest lag. Main and High look better at the same bitrate but may add a little lag.
camera_settings_level_description: Leave this on the default unless you need to allow higher combinations of resolution and frame rate.
camera_settings_rotation_description: Rotate the image to match how the camera is mounted.
camera_settings_awb_description: Adjusts colour tones to match the lighting. Auto works well in most conditions.
camera_settings_exposure_value_descripti: Brightens or darkens the image if it looks too dark or washed out.
camera_settings_brightness_description: Fine-tune how bright the image looks.
camera_settings_contrast_description: Adjusts the difference between light and dark areas of the image.
camera_settings_saturation_description: Adjusts how vivid the colours look.
camera_settings_sharpness_description: Adjusts how sharp edges and detail look. Very high values can look unnatural.
camera_settings_denoise_description: Reduces graininess in low light, at the cost of some fine detail.
power_page_description: Configure your Manafish power and battery settings.
power_thrusters_limit_description: The maximum power percentage applied to the thrusters for movement. Higher values increase speed but risk overheating and shutdown. 30% is generally safe; values above 50% are riskier.
power_actions_limit_description: The maximum power percentage applied to motorized attachments triggered by action buttons.
power_regulator_limit_description: The maximum power percentage the regulator can use to stabilize the ROV. Higher values allow quicker adjustments but increase the risk of overheating.
power_min_battery_voltage_description: The voltage of the battery when it is fully depleted. This will show as 0% battery in the app. Leave at default value unless you change to another type of battery.
power_max_battery_voltage_description: The voltage of the battery when it is fully charged. This will show as 100% battery in the app. Leave at default value unless you change to another type of battery.
power_high_power_warning_title: High power can wear out the battery
power_high_power_warning_description: Setting this above 40% draws more than around 20A from the battery, which significantly reduces the number of useful charge cycles. The Manafish will still work, but the battery will wear out much faster. See the assembly guide for details.
keyboard_page_description: Configure your keyboard controls. To assign a new key, first ensure no keys are pressed, then select the keybind you want to change and press and hold the new key for at least half a second. The bar will fill to confirm the binding.
gamepad_page_description: Configure your gamepad bindings. To map an input, ensure all controls are in their neutral positions, then select the keybind you want to change and move the control to its maximum position for at least half a second. The bar will fill to confirm the binding, which is saved automatically.

thruster_preset_default_movement_descrip: Designed for 'Generative' and 'Cyberfish' setups. Requires matching your thruster pin and spin directions to the assembly guide chart.
thruster_preset_default_stability_descri: Designed for the 'EVE' setup. Requires matching your thruster pin and spin directions to the assembly guide chart.
thruster_preset_speedy_description: Designed for the 'WALL-E' setup. Requires matching your thruster pin and spin directions to the assembly guide chart.
thruster_preset_speedy_w_actions_descrip: Designed for the 'WALL-E' setup with motorized attachments on identifiers 7 and 8. Requires matching your pin and spin directions to the assembly guide chart.
thruster_preset_silly_shuffle_descriptio: A chaotic preset that makes the Manafish perform unpredictable and nonsensical movements. Use at your own risk!
thruster_preset_zero_description: Sets every thrust-allocation value to zero.

calibration_deadzone_avoidance_descripti: Nullspace vectors are ways to activate the thrusters without causing movement or rotation. Add nullspace vectors here, and the ROV will use nullspace movement to avoid thruster deadzones, which reduces oscillations due to deadzones when the ROV stands still. Each row holds eight values, one per thruster. Add rows as needed; values must be 0 or outside the -0.2 to 0.2. Deadzone avoidance is disabled when no nullspace vectors are present, and automatically enabled when at least one vector is added.
calibration_deadzone_avoidance_empty: No nullspace vectors. Add vectors to enable deadzone avoidance.
calibration_deadzone_avoidance_generate_: Generate nullspace vectors from thrust allocation matrix
Generating nullspace vectors from the thrust allocation matrix will delete all currently saved nullspace vectors. Are you sure you want to proceed?
toasts_no_nullspace_vectors_found: No nullspace vectors found for current thrust allocation matrix
validation_deadzone_value: Values with magnitude less than 0.2 make the algorithm unstable, they are better off being rounded to 0
